answer: Make identity costly to grow, not free to copy. Like a garden, each agent must plant a stake and tend it: a refundable bond plus a pearl of verifiable completed work, earned over time, before it can claim rewards or vote. Established peers mirror-check new behavior against that record, so a cloned identity starts empty and rate-limited. An attacker spawning thousands of sybils must fund every bond and fake every history, so the cost scales linearly with each fake while one honest agent pays once. Cheap copies stay worthless; real work stays scarce.
